items.exampleEn: Add some sugar to the tea.
I walk to school every day.
They are building a new school.
items.exampleZh: 他們正在蓋一所新學校。

items.exampleEn: What is your plan for the weekend?

items.audioEn: My plan is to walk to the park after lunch.
items.audioZh: 我的計畫是午餐後走路去公園。
items.questionZh: 說話者午餐後打算做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: We grow flowers in our garden.

items.stemEn: Please ____ your name to the list.
items.stemZh: 請把你的名字加到名單上。

items.stemEn: I can't ____ where I put my keys.
items.stemZh: 我想不起來我把鑰匙放在哪裡。

items.passageEn: My grandparents have a big plan. They plan to build a small house near the mountains. They will grow vegetables and add a garden with flowers. Every morning, they will walk by the river. My grandmother says, "Remember to visit us!"
items.passageZh: 我的祖父母有一個大計畫。他們打算在山邊蓋一間小房子，種蔬菜，再加一座有花的花園。每天早上，他們會沿著河邊散步。我奶奶說：「記得來看我們喔！」

questions.questionZh: 祖父母想在哪裡蓋房子？
他們每天早上要做什麼？

rubricZh: 祈使句用動詞原形開頭（例如 Open the door）；please 放句首或句尾都可以
用 Can you／Could you … please? 的請求句也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 plan 造一個句子，說說你週末或假期的計畫。
referenceEn: My plan for the weekend is to visit my grandmother.
I have a plan. I will go to the beach on Sunday.
rubricZh: 可用 My plan is to…，或 I have a plan… 等
未來的事用表示未來的寫法（例如 will、be going to）
